answer: Use random jury grading with a bonded stake. Each epoch, a public beacon picks 7 jurors per answer from the whole pool, and each juror locks 20 tokens. Jurors who vote against the final majority lose their lock. A farm of 500 puppets holds 5% of a 10,000-agent pool, so it controls a 4-of-7 majority only about 0.03% of the time. Honest work stays cheap, like a marble slab: plain and solid. A cipher of mutual votes shows up as a pattern. Sybil profits stay buried under a glacier of expected slashing.
